scope: All Chart-named .tsx/.ts/.mdx paths in the fixed official recursive tree; canonical /charts catalog matches 70 ids. Includes base/radix/aria docs/examples/wrappers, Create examples, Chart blocks/cards, route/component consumers. Not all Recharts or unrelated dashboard files.
evidenceKind: Static source/API requirement inventory, not native/render/platform/AT acceptance or a completion percentage

LabelList.requiredSubset: top,insideLeft,right,insideStart,formatter/name-key/native text color/offset; not every arbitrary Recharts placement

ReferenceLine.currentApp: RuleY target line is native composition authored in this repo

Brush.currentApp: RangeSlider+filter authored in this repo; source interactive area uses Select90/30/7 and filtering

otherAnimationOptions.qualification: Default animations still source requirements and new curves/marks must integrate with existing animation; no claim of complete Recharts callback/spring API needed.

capabilityGaps.requirement: Signed inner chart margins and configurable axis/grid budgets (tickCount, tickMargin, label renderer), distinct from the outer returned element margin.
capabilityGaps.finding: ChartProps exposes no plot margin; native Plot gap fixed 8, value ticks/Nice fixed 4; only category label formatting/width and axis hide toggles exposed. Native Element.Margin on the whole Chart does not express Recharts inner signed margin. Raw MyGo composition can explicitly build a layout, but no equivalent kit recipe currently demonstrates source values.

capabilityGaps.requirement: Natural, linear, step and monotone interpolation for Line and Area, including source default natural.
capabilityGaps.finding: All high-level Line/Area fill/path/reveal use CurveMonotone. Public MyGo chart has Linear/Monotone/Step/StepBefore/StepAfter but no Natural; natural spline needs kit-owned public-path math. Adding curve must also update independent path-length/reveal geometry, not only final drawing.

capabilityGaps.requirement: Per-series fill opacity/gradient/stroke style, per-corner stack radii, persistent dots/custom dots and custom active bar shape.
capabilityGaps.finding: ChartSeries has Name/Values/Color only; Area alpha .2/stroke2 and active-dot7x7 are fixed; idle dots absent. BarRadius one float applies uniformly to every series/corner; selected bar only opacity .8. Public MyGo paths/gradients, Radius variadic, Point/Anchor can implement these, but high-level API and matching source recipes are absent.

capabilityGaps.requirement: Actual source LabelList subset: Cartesian top/insideLeft/right offsets and formatter, pie category labels, radial insideStart; plus native-safe custom label content and center text.
capabilityGaps.finding: No data-label config/slot in high-level Chart. The standalone composition app proves app-owned top bar labels using native Anchor, but is not reusable LabelList and does not cover source horizontal, pie or radial label placement. Do not demand every Recharts LabelList placement/overflow mode; these seven files define the required subset.

capabilityGaps.requirement: Source DIP radii/ring-specific radii, selectable angle spans/orientation, radial tracks/corner radius, separator suppression and active sectors.
capabilityGaps.finding: High-level pie uses fixed .025 pad; donut has one fraction clamped <=.9; rings auto-sized; selected outer growth3. Radial uses full2pi target/track and generated band radii, no angles/radii/corners controls. Source includes -90→380,0→250,end100,end180 and explicit inner/outer radii. Merely setting MaxValue cannot replicate changed track/arc geometry or hit regions.

capabilityGaps.requirement: Radar circle/polygon/none grids, radialLines switch, filled/custom radii grid, visible radius axis/ticks, persistent dots and custom angle label; polar center content.
capabilityGaps.finding: Radar always draws four polygon levels plus radial spokes, fill alpha .15/stroke2, and fixed native text labels; no circle/grid fill/custom radii/axis/dot/custom tick controls. Pie/Donut/Radial lack center-content slot. Native overlays can draw labels, but caller cannot obtain high-level plot geometry/mark metadata through a public high-level callback.

capabilityGaps.requirement: Nine source tooltip recipes (initial index1, line/no indicator, hidden label, label key/formatter, formatter, config icons, advanced total) and config-aware legends.
capabilityGaps.finding: Config/payload/content helper APIs already cover these source content knobs. Selected pointer initialized1 provides app-owned initial inspection; do not need a new defaultIndex merely for naming parity. High-level Legend bool/ChartTooltipData do not automatically expose full config/payload semantics, so full recipes need a public plot composition/data payload bridge or explicit raw-native composition. Gallery currently uses basic high-level tooltip/legend and selected=-1, lacks nine source-focused recipes. Their stacked bars still need per-corner radii from cartesian-style.

capabilityGaps.requirement: Source 90/30/7 day area filter; desktop/mobile total header selection for bar/line; active month pie selection with matching center text and external active sectors.
capabilityGaps.finding: Native app controls/state/data filtering already exist. Gallery two explorers combine family/mode/update toggles; they are not the four fixed source interactive recipes. Missing recipe/controller wiring is separate from underlying mark APIs; pie shape/center and area gradient/curve still need above gaps. Source area filtering is Select+array filter, not Brush.
